titre: Heures de coupure par client aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Heures par client et par an, moyenne 2014 à 2023 et année 2024

Moyenne annuelle 2014 à 2023.texte: compared with an average of nearly four hours per year in 2014 through 2023

2024.texte: an average of 11 hours of electricity interruptions in 2024, or nearly twice as many as the annual average experienced in the decade before

Événements majeurs.texte: Interruptions attributed to major events averaged nearly nine hours in 2024

Autres coupures.texte: Service interruptions that aren't triggered by major events routinely average about two hours per year
